description.value: The Clubhouse Restaurant sits at the edge of The Willows Golf Course on Moresby Island in Haida Gwaii—one of the most remote destinations in British Columbia—with a patio overlooking the ocean. The menu leans into casual coastal comfort: Haida Gwaii fish and chips, seared tuna, flatbread pizzas, and stacked burgers, alongside a newly added specialty coffee café. For a touring cyclist who has made it this far out to 'the edge of the world,' it serves as a genuine community hub and a rare full-service meal stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active restaurant at Hekate's Retreat—'The Clubhouse Restaurant'—with a café, patio, ocean views, and a full menu (lunch, dinner, Sunday brunch). OSM and website agree on address (342 School Road, V0T 1T0) and phone (250-637-2207). OSM operator tag reads 'Hektate's Retreat' but the website consistently spells it 'Hekate's Retreat', which is a likely typo in OSM. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned on the website; toilets are indicated by OSM (toilets=yes, toilets:access=permissive) and not contradicted by the website.
concerns: OSM operator tag reads 'Hektate's Retreat' but the business website consistently uses 'Hekate's Retreat' — likely a typo in OSM.
OSM name is 'Clubhouse Restaurant' while website uses 'The Clubhouse Restaurant' — minor discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed via website. A rare full-service food stop in an extremely remote cycling destination on Haida Gwaii.
enrichment_extras.notes: Part of the broader Hekate's Retreat property, which also offers accommodations (cabins, heritage house, RV sites), a 9-hole golf course, nordic sauna, and pickleball. The property also rents e-bikes for local adventures, though no e-bike charging station for visitors is mentioned.
